I recommend this clinic.
They have several specialist doctors, they are friendly and patient, and the prices are reasonable.

I waited so long for my wisdom tooth extraction. I waited half an hour before seeing the doctor.
On stitch removal day, I waited over 20 minutes for some unknown reason. It was so long.
There was no parking. I had to go elsewhere. The price wasn't any cheaper than anywhere else.

I'm a frequent visitor here. I've had my teeth cleaned, filled, and crowned here twice already. It's my go-to clinic. The service is excellent, and the dentists are gentle. From what I've seen with three dentists, they're all very attentive. The staff are lovely, the clinic is clean, and the restrooms are spotless. You can park in front of the clinic on even/odd days, or park for free at Burn Busarak on Soi 19.

The clinic was aware that the doctor canceled patient appointments and made no attempt to find a free slot to resolve the issue. They even tried to adjust their own schedule to match the doctor's, but the doctor shifted his clinic schedule back and forth more than twice and canceled appointments frequently. If the doctor takes on outside work that clashes with existing patient schedules, they should ask the patients beforehand if they are available to adjust their schedule. I've now had four teeth extracted and haven't had braces adjusted for over a month. The service is terrible, and there's absolutely no responsibility towards the patient! 👎🏻

Think carefully before getting braces here. The doctor doesn't follow up on cases, changes their clinic schedule very frequently, and patients have to constantly adjust their own schedules, leaving them with no free time to see the doctor. There's a complete lack of responsibility from both the doctor and the staff. It's a huge waste of time. Honestly, I wouldn't even give them one star.

The doctor is good, and the reception staff are also good.
I've been using their services since I was a teenager.
I wasn't very good at taking care of my teeth, but the doctor gave me great advice.

I had a filling done, but now my gums are swollen and inflamed, my tooth is sensitive, and the filling has fallen out. They say it didn't fall out, that everything is fine. Basically, I wasted my money.

I had a cavity and needed a tooth extraction for the first time in my life, and also required a dental implant because it was a front tooth. I was quite panicked.

A colleague recommended this clinic, so I came for a consultation. The consultation was excellent; the doctor made me feel much more at ease after my panic attack. The doctor and all the staff were very helpful and provided thorough consultation.

And when it was time for the extraction and implant, it was practically painless. There was almost no pain afterward, and the price was reasonable.

Highly recommended! 👍🏻

text: I had two wisdom teeth taken out here separately and both times it was a great experience considering the type of procedure. Barely any discomfort, good service, doctors speak English, and prompt follow up. Highly recommend.

My first time scaling my teeth in 24 years. The service was great from the counter. I called to ask questions and they were very friendly. When I went in, they were very friendly and the doctor was kind. At first, I was very scared, scared of the pain, I was scared to death haha. But actually, it didn't hurt at all. The doctor had a light hand. During the procedure, they talked very well, giving advice and asking all the time, "Does it hurt? Is this okay? Is it okay?" If it hurts, you can tell me. They told me to stop, to rest. Asked me to turn left and right. When I turned, they thanked me the whole time. They spoke politely and were very cute. Very impressed. The assistants were also very cute. The clinic was clean and the service was good.

I had a pre-scheduled appointment at 4:30 PM on Monday. I needed to submit a leave request to my company to see the dentist.

The clinic called at 4:10 PM to inform me that the doctor had an urgent matter and the appointment was cancelled. What does that mean??

I tried a lot of different places, including really fancy and luxurious ones and Japanese ones, but I decided to go with this one because there was always someone waiting whenever I passed by, and it was the right choice.
I would have liked to keep the tooth if possible, but it took a lot of talking before I was told I had no choice but to have it extracted, so I had one molar removed, but apart from the slight pain from the anaesthetic injection, it was virtually painless.
The price was reasonable, and for now I'd give it 5 stars.
